description: This PHP class defines the view controller for editing calendar account records within the SuiteCRM application. It extends the ViewEdit class and manages pre-display logic such as initializing calendar source types, setting user IDs, and displaying messages for users with existing personal calendar accounts. It also injects a JavaScript variable indicating the admin status of the current user.

classes.name: CalendarAccountViewEdit
classes.description: A view class responsible for editing calendar account details in the suiteCRM platform.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the edit view by initializing calendar source types, setting user IDs, checking user account status, and injecting admin status into JavaScript.
